explication: EventOne is a full-stack event-management platform: users discover events, register and check in, then leave reviews; organizers create and manage events, while admins moderate them. The React app routes users to role-specific dashboards and the Express API exposes the corresponding domain endpoints. Registration handles capacity, QR codes, notifications, and email; event and review controllers persist domain data. The map combines sampled calls with README capabilities and SOURCE INDEX references; some frontend-to-API interactions and unsampled features are shown only as unverified links.
